description: This file defines template classes for key-value pairs, including a generic KeyValueType and a specialized TextKeyValueType with case sensitivity options. It provides methods for construction, assignment, comparison, and key access, and is part of the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and access methods.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A specialized template class inheriting from KeyValueType for text fragments with case sensitivity control.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying or moving key-value pairs.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two key-value objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two key-value objects.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns a reference to the key component.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the value component.

methods.name: IsKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key matches the stored key.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if the TextKeyValueType has a non-empty key.

methods.name: IsKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided TextFragment matches the key, considering case sensitivity.
